419:t_1:169.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I don't much like how you talk, deciding things about people.」

419:t_1:170.en:
$$マリ$$
「Remember this, $$ニコラ$$. A real boy always wants, deep down, to become a grown-up.」

419:t_1:171.en:
$$マリ$$
「Being a boy isn't the opposite of being an adult... It means you're on your way to becoming one.」

419:t_1:173.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Don't tell me you...」

419:t_1:174.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Whoa there, $$チコ$$. Don't go blabbing anything unnecessary to the Princess.」

419:t_1:175.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just so you know, for me 《$$あがり$$》 is still a long way off.」

419:t_1:177.en:
$$マリ$$
(Twisted, aren't they, this one and that one...)

419:t_1:178.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's not it, $$レド$$. I told you, Captain $$アムロ$$ likes to give the arm laykers more play.」

419:t_1:180.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「That's only a rough guide.」

419:t_1:181.en:
$$サックス$$
「A machine only means something because of the person who uses it. Don't forget that.」

419:t_1:182.en:
$$イアン$$
「And a mechanic is the one who links the machine and the pilot.」

419:t_1:184.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What's with you? Did you think we were just mechanics?」

419:t_1:185.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「We're $c's maintenance crew. The strongest mechanics are what support the strongest unit, after all.」

419:t_1:186.en:
$$レド$$
「...Sorry. All I ever do is hold everyone back.」

419:t_1:187.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't worry about it. Every one of the guys here got trained by their own boss while causing that boss trouble.」

419:t_1:188.en:
$$ランド$$
「In my case, I got taught how a person ought to live, smile and all.」

419:t_1:190.en:
$$サックス$$
「Well then... that's the full round of checks done.」

419:t_1:191.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Then last up is $$チェインバー#pilot$$. $$レド$$... you do it yourself.」

419:t_1:192.en:
$$レド$$
「But the $$マシンキャリバー$$ has a self-maintenance mechanism...」

419:t_1:193.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you talking about?! We do it by hand so we're ready for when that thing breaks down!」

419:t_1:194.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Go do it with thanks for everything it does, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:198.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will transition to maintenance mode. From here on, everything is entrusted to Ensign $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:200.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's a good thing, isn't it, chatting with your beloved machine.」

419:t_1:201.en:
$$イアン$$
「Still can't get the $$ガンレオン$$'s hatch open?」

419:t_1:203.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「You're awfully carefree for someone in that state.」

419:t_1:204.en:
$$サックス$$
「Yeah... And you had such a grim face before $$レド$$ came.」

419:t_1:205.en:
$$ランド$$
「Training that kid reminded me, for the first time in ages, of when the Boss drilled the basics of repair into me.」

419:t_1:206.en:
$$ランド$$
「I may look like a full-fledged mechanic now, but back then I was a hopeless brat...」

419:t_1:207.en:
$$ランド$$
「But back then, there was nothing I was afraid of... All I did was work as hard as I could, eat, and sleep, but I was confident I couldn't lose to anything...」

419:t_1:210.en:
$$イアン$$
「I understand, $$ランド$$. I'm the same as you.」

419:t_1:212.en:
$$イアン$$
「I can never stand up to $$リンダ$$, either.」

419:t_1:214.en:
$$サックス$$
「In the end, I couldn't put up with that, and so I ended my marriage.」

419:t_1:215.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「I see. So all of you are henpecked... you lose to your wives, is that it?」

419:t_1:216.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Is this useful for your future, $$アストナージ$$? I've heard about this Lieutenant $$ケーラ$$.」

419:t_1:217.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Ah, you've got me...」

419:t_1:218.en:
$$ランド$$
「W-what's with this warm and fuzzy mood...!」

419:t_1:219.en:
$$メール$$
「Conclusion! Men are weak against their wives! What Darling fears these days is me!」

419:t_2:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

419:t_2:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...That concludes the reports from $$エルーナルーナ$$ and $$バルビエル$$.」

419:t_2:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「More options are better.」

419:t_2:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「So it comes down to a direct confrontation in the end...」

419:t_2:10.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「With this, the plan moves forward again...」

419:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「To think you'd overcome the $$スフィアの反作用$$ in such a short time.」

419:t_2:17.en:
$n
「I could get back on my feet thanks to everyone. It wasn't my own strength.」

419:t_2:18.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you got the knack of it, didn't you? You should be able to manage on your own from here.」

419:t_2:19.en:
$$シン$$
「The new $$ジェニオン$$ motion you were practicing is finished, too.」

419:t_2:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「You'd better thank us for helping with your special training.」

419:t_2:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Knock it off. Just because you're starting to stop being the quiet type doesn't mean anyone wants your smile.」

419:t_2:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, now you've got a prospect of fighting on your own. Shouldn't you be happier about it?」

419:t_2:24.en:
$n
「No... not yet. I can't let my guard down until we get Miss $$スズネ$$ back... and until we take back the Earth.」

419:t_2:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「But once we get Miss $$スズネ$$ back, a new problem will arise.」

419:t_2:29.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's it, I've decided! I'm going to challenge Miss $$スズネ$$!」

419:t_2:31.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So make sure you rescue Miss $$スズネ$$, no matter what. I don't want to lose by forfeit.」

419:t_2:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「But even after seeing $$ギルター$$ today, $$バルビエル$$ will come at us with some move we can't even imagine.」
